# ek

> ek (Evaluation Kit) -- a framework for building Knowledge Evaluation systems (evaluating information-extraction outputs; OCR as the noisiest special case)

- [ek.metrics.fields](_autosummary/ek.metrics.fields.html.md): Field-level metric for record / dict-shaped extractions.
- [ek.metrics.graphs](_autosummary/ek.metrics.graphs.html.md): The flagship metric: cost-weighted, type-aware distance over a typed graph.
- [ek.metrics.spans](_autosummary/ek.metrics.spans.html.md): Span / slot precision-recall-F1 over two backends that legitimately disagree.
- [ek.metrics.strings](_autosummary/ek.metrics.strings.html.md): String metrics: Character/Word Error Rate (CER/WER).

- [ek.qe.decide](_autosummary/ek.qe.decide.html.md): Selective prediction: turn a calibrated probability into accept / flag / block.
- [ek.qe.signals](_autosummary/ek.qe.signals.html.md): Intrinsic confidence signals: token logprobs and per-unit posteriors (cost tier 2).
- [ek.qe.verifiers](_autosummary/ek.qe.verifiers.html.md): Deterministic verifier signals – the cheapest, first-to-run QE layer.

- [ek.harness](_autosummary/ek.harness.html.md): The offline evaluation harness: run a predictor over gold, gate regressions.
